_about: The village record (Ending, scripts/ending/ending.gd; README.md, Ending): what the ending looks at and how it grades it. DESIGN lists the ending as not studied, so every rule here is ours. It plays once, on the first morning of year 3 (triggers_house.json), and the game goes on afterwards. categories: in the order shown, each {id, name, measure, steps, unit?}: measure is one of the numbers Game.ending_values() works out (shipped_value: G of everything ever shipped at today's prices; crop_kinds: crops shipped at least once; animal_care: animals at half happiness or more; heart_bands: the villagers' heart bands added up; mine_deepest; fish_kinds: kinds ever caught; house_built: extensions finished; tool_levels: levels above 1 over the five field tools; contest_wins; recipes_known); a star for every step reached. ranks: by stars in all, each {min, title}, the highest min reached wins. friend_band: the villager with the most points is the closing speaker if their band is at least this (else Tome, as the village elder). Steps are set so a casual two years lands around Village Farmer (16-23 stars), the steady plan of tools/balance.py (most crops, a full coop and barn, every extension, daily talks) around Keeper of the Satoyama (24-32), and the top rank needs nearly everything. Crops: 11 kinds; spring's three earn a star, summer's make 6-7, the last two stars need most of fall's four and rice. Recipes: 13, 4 known from the start (no star), the four lessons, the radio and the two bin cards bring the rest; all 13 for the last star.
